name: RSI trader v0.15
summary: This EA trades based on RSI overbought/oversold signals, entering buy positions when RSI crosses below the oversold level and sell positions when RSI crosses above the overbought level. It implements configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit with RSI period and threshold customization. Version 0.15 suggests an early-stage iterative development of a straightforward RSI momentum/reversal strategy.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买超卖信号进行交易，当RSI下穿超卖水平时买入，当RSI上穿超买水平时卖出。它实现了可配置的手数、止损和止盈，并允许自定义RSI周期和阈值。版本号v0.15表明这是一个处于早期迭代开发阶段的简单RSI动量/反转策略。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RSI指标的动量反转逻辑，认为价格在触及超买或超卖区域后会发生回归。入场条件为RSI从超卖区域向上穿越时开多单，RSI从超买区域向下穿越时开空单。出场条件依赖预设的固定止损和止盈水平，没有动态追踪止盈或移动止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏仓位比例控制，用户需手动设置合理手数以控制风险。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但缺乏过滤条件和多时间框架确认，容易在震荡行情中频繁止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on RSI momentum reversal logic, assuming price will revert after reaching overbought or oversold zones. Entry conditions trigger a buy when RSI crosses up from the oversold level and a sell when RSI crosses down from the overbought level. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels with no dynamic trailing stop or adaptive exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management lacks percentage-based position control, requiring the user to manually set appropriate lot sizes to manage risk. The overall strategy logic is simple and direct but lacks filtering conditions and multi-timeframe confirmation, making it prone to frequent stop-outs in ranging markets.

parameters.name: Take Profit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: RSI Applied Price
parameters.description_en: Price type used for RSI calculation

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
参数可配置性强，用户可以灵活调整RSI周期和阈值
基于经典技术指标RSI，具有理论依据和广泛认知度
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
Highly configurable parameters allow flexible adjustment of RSI period and thresholds
Based on the classic RSI indicator with theoretical foundation and wide recognition
cons: 缺乏多时间框架确认和趋势过滤，震荡市中容易频繁亏损
固定手数没有资金管理比例控制，风险敞口不可控
没有移动止损或动态出场机制，盈利可能大幅回撤
止损和止盈默认值为0，新手用户可能忽略设置导致无限风险
缺乏新K线检测，同一根K线内可能重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and trend filter, prone to frequent losses in ranging markets
Fixed lot sizing without equity-based money management leads to uncontrolled risk exposure
No trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism, profits may give back significantly
Stop loss and take profit default to 0, novice users may overlook setting them leading to unlimited risk
Lacks new bar detection, potentially opening multiple positions within the same bar
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如MA或ADX）避免在震荡行情中逆势交易
实现基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位管理
添加移动止损和部分平仓功能以锁定利润
增加新K线检测机制防止同一根K线内重复开仓
增加点差过滤避免在高点差时段交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (e.g., MA or ADX) to avoid counter-trend trades in ranging markets
Add trailing stop and partial close functionality to lock in profits
Add new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate entries within the same bar
Add spread filter to avoid trading during high-spread periods

risk_points: 止损和止盈默认值为0，可能导致无限制的亏损
缺乏新K线检测，可能在同一K线内重复开仓导致过度暴露
没有账户资金比例控制，大仓位可能导致快速爆仓
缺乏点差过滤，高点差时入场成本过高
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit default to 0, potentially leading to unlimited losses
Lacks new bar detection, may open duplicate positions within the same bar causing overexposure
No account equity percentage control, large lots can cause rapid account blow-up
No spread filter, entry costs may be excessive during high-spread periods
